measuredOn: Google Pixel 10a, API 37, fingerprint google/stallion/stallion:17/CP2A.260805.005/2026081301:user/release-keys. Every baseline here is from one real-device run on 2026-08-27 (phase 5 ticket 06), re-recorded wholesale against the redesign and ticket 36's full fixture rebuild rather than mixing old and new numbers. The device sat idle and cooling for 15 minutes before this run (battery temperature 26.3C at the start of the wait, 25.9C at the end, screen off throughout) - the rested-device methodology ticket 03 asked for, folded into this recording per ticket 06's own scope. Every one of the 31 pre-existing measurements moved by -33% to +24% against the 2026-08-19 recording, consistent, mixed-direction and explainable by fixture growth and ordinary device noise - none of the broad, mostly one-directional +5%-to-+360% drift ticket 03 found on a warm device reproduced here, which answers what ticket 03 was asking for by construction. targetMs for the 9 new measurements is picked by analogy to an existing measurement's own device-observed cost, not derived from the web probe's targets, the same reasoning ticket 02's verification note gives for the original five.
fixture: seed 1, 3653 days ending epoch day 20676: 3291 entries over 2634 days with entries, 422 photos (394MB on disk), 125 lab results, 12 milestones, 24 tags. 265 entries carry a body-region euphoria or dysphoria value. Three regimen episodes (phase 5 ticket 36/38): oral Estradiol from day 30 (Monday/Wednesday/Friday, two-amount schedule, 1475 dose events, 95% of expected slots), Spironolactone for ~500 days in the middle (daily, ends well before the fixture's last 90 days), and injectable Estradiol valerate for the final 150 days (weekly, im) - the last two overlap the first, so a stretch of the fixture has two concurrently active episodes. 19 hair-progress stagings and 5 dated photos. A year each (irregular cadence, ending at the fixture's last day) of measurements, size records, hair-removal sessions, wear sessions and cycle events; a handful of side effects, personal effects, roadmap checks, letters, tryouts and one surgical procedure across the whole decade; ~16 voice recordings; one drug's stock count recorded years ago (so its projection reads the whole dose log) and one recorded near the end (so it doesn't). Encryption on: SQLCipher under the Android Keystore data key, photos through app-private file storage.
